_comment: Secondary override rules applied BEFORE the main category_mapping.json rules.
Use these for ambiguous subcategories where the Product Name or Model / SKU must
be inspected to determine the correct M10 sheet and block.
trigger_subcategory_contains - list of substrings; override fires if ANY matches the row's Subcategory
rules                   - checked in order; first keyword match wins
check_fields          - list of source column names to search (concatenated)
keyword_contains      - row matches if ANY keyword is a substring (case-insensitive)

overrides._comment: LG 'Specialty' covers both fridge and freezer models. Inspect name/SKU to disambiguate.
